chip_dark_full: A story about a 4-year-old child who is afraid of the dark and won't fall asleep alone. Let them find a magical helper and learn to deal with it.
chip_teeth_full: A story about a 5-year-old child who hates brushing teeth. Let a friendly tooth fairy show what happens to neglected teeth.
chip_doctor_full: A story about a 3-year-old child who is scared to visit the doctor. Let them befriend a kind animal-doctor and realize there's nothing to fear.
chip_garden_full: A story about a 4-year-old going to kindergarten for the first time and feeling anxious. Let them find kind friends and realize it can be fun.
chip_swim_full: A story about a 5-year-old learning to swim and a little afraid of water. Let them meet an underwater friend who shows water can be your friend.
